The abstract describes a multivariable integrated evaluation of CMIP6 models combined with anThe abstract describes a multivariable integrated evaluation of CMIP6 models combined with an analysis of their interdependency using similarity of multivariate error fields and hierarchical clustering. It does not mention Bayesian hierarchical modeling, the “replicate Earth” paradigm, area‑weighted metrics, a multivariable integrated skill score, or genetic algorithms—all central elements of the four candidate hypotheses. Consequently, none of the proposed hypotheses is fully aligned with the evidence presented in the study.

CHOICE: NONE
